task.description: Design and add comprehensive test coverage for OBS-02. Write requirement test spec at tests/specs/OBS-02.md and add/extend deterministic unit and integration tests for /metrics response contract, required metric families and labels, histogram emission behavior, non-blocking scrape behavior, and DB-outage stale-data handling. Ensure tests are stable and do not depend on nondeterministic timing. Complete the handoff with produced artifacts and any issues.
acceptance_criteria: OBS-02 has a test spec before new test code
At least one automated test covers each OBS-02 MUST acceptance criterion
Tests verify metrics labels and content-type contract for /metrics
Tests cover DB outage/stale gauge edge case and non-blocking scrape behavior
No new test depends on uncontrolled wall-clock time or random values

result.summary: Test specs and test code for OBS-02 covering endpoint contract, required metrics/labels, histogram emission, non-blocking scrape behavior, and DB-outage stale-data behavior.
